name: reelspan
title: Reelspan
description: Publish videos, photos and text to TikTok, YouTube, Instagram, X, LinkedIn and more; check results, scheduled posts and history.
author: fabwaseem

commands.name: create-post
commands.title: Create Post
commands.subtitle: Reelspan
commands.description: Publish or schedule text, a video or photos to your networks.

commands.name: post-history
commands.title: Post History
commands.subtitle: Reelspan
commands.description: Recent posts with each network's result and link; retry the failed ones.

commands.name: scheduled-posts
commands.title: Scheduled Posts
commands.subtitle: Reelspan
commands.description: Posts waiting for their time; cancel or open them.

commands.name: profiles
commands.title: Profiles
commands.subtitle: Reelspan
commands.description: Your profiles and connected networks; copy a connect link.

tools.name: get-profiles
tools.title: Get Profiles
tools.description: Lists the user's Reelspan profiles (brands) and the networks each has connected. Use it to find the profile username before posting.

tools.name: create-post
tools.title: Create Post
tools.description: Publishes or schedules a post to social networks through Reelspan: text, or a video or photos from public URLs or local file paths.

tools.name: get-post-status
tools.title: Get Post Status
tools.description: Gets each network's result and link for a post by its request ID (or a scheduled post's job ID).

tools.name: get-post-history
tools.title: Get Post History
tools.description: Lists recent posts, one row per network, newest first.

tools.name: get-scheduled-posts
tools.title: Get Scheduled Posts
tools.description: Lists posts waiting for their scheduled time.

tools.name: cancel-scheduled-post
tools.title: Cancel Scheduled Post
tools.description: Cancels a scheduled post by its job ID so it is never published.

ai.instructions: Reelspan publishes to social networks. A profile (username) is one brand with its connected accounts: call get-profiles first unless the user named one or set a default. Only post to networks the profile has connected. Times are ISO-8601; pass the user's timezone with a scheduled time.
